observations: Site-level water data is 2022 only (9 operated sites: 4 Elk Valley coal mines, Highland Valley Copper, Red Dog, Carmen de Andacollo, Quebrada Blanca, Trail smelter). Corporate (all operations) and mining-operations totals cover 2016-2022; quality/source breakdowns cover 2021-2022. Non-operated Antamina and closed sites (Cardinal River, Coal Mountain, Pend Oreille) have no water data in this file.

Trail Operations (smelter, not a mine) accounts for 69,626 of 117,327 ML (59%) of 2022 withdrawals, almost entirely high-quality surface water (68,232 ML, T97); "Mining Operations" totals exclude Trail (47,701 ML).

Water-stressed areas: only Carmen de Andacollo and Quebrada Blanca (Chile) are classified as water-stressed (WRI Aqueduct); 25% of sites. Water-stressed withdrawal 12,639 ML in 2022 vs 12,580.6 ML in 2021, 99% high-quality water (mostly groundwater at CdA).

Other managed water (184,327 ML in 2022, all at mining operations and mostly Elk Valley coal: Fording River 82,808, Elkview 44,262) exceeds operational withdrawals and drives total discharge (235,671 ML); discharge > withdrawal is therefore expected for Teck.

Consumption exceeds withdrawal at Highland Valley Copper (24,212 vs 17,180 ML) and Quebrada Blanca (2,305 vs 2,139 ML) in 2022, consistent with drawdown of stored water; corporate change of storage is 13,079 ML (2022) and 9,107.7 ML (2021).

Trend (all operations): withdrawal 117,931 ML (2016) -> 128,146 (2018 peak) -> 117,327 (2022); consumption fell from 62,033 ML (2018) to 52,904 ML (2022); reuse/recycle volume fell from 176,563 ML (2017) to 134,131 ML (2022) and the reuse rate from 80% (2017) to 74% (2022).

Terminology change: "water withdrawal" was previously "water withdrawal for use"/"new water use"; "other managed water" was previously "water withdrawal discharged without use"; "operational water use" was previously "total water use". Surface water includes precipitation/runoff not diverted around operations, so there is no separate rain/runoff source.

Reuse rate cells (row 27 / row 77) store fractions displayed as % (0.74 = 74%); converted to percent. Intensities are m3 per tonne of ore or raw coal processed (operational water use intensity, row 78) and m3 of new water per tonne processed (row 79, recorded as water_intensity_reported); Quebrada Blanca and Trail intensities are "N/A". The Teck-level intensity is on a mining-operations basis.

Layout artefact: rows 95, 115 and 136 of the site-level 2022 tables contain stray year labels (2021, 2020, 2019 ... 2015) under the header row; these do not correspond to the data, which are 2022 per the table titles.

The 2021 quality table carries unrounded values that differ trivially from the 2021 trend row (e.g. withdrawal 117,262.45532 in E160 vs 117,262.45477 in C14) and shows a negative low-quality groundwater OMW value of -0.00042 ML at water-stressed operations (J162).

No water restatements are listed on the Restatements sheet (only 2021 waste figures). No water-related incidents, fines or production/ore-processed data are included in this workbook (production referenced to the Annual Report). Policies sheet references the Elk Valley Water Quality Plan and Water Stewardship Strategy/Goals (links only, no numeric targets in file).
Site values (9 operations) sum exactly to the Teck totals for withdrawal, other managed water, discharge, consumption, reuse and operational water use in 2022.
